required: capture-package or compact IQ input for each seed
calibration/test frame split and physical reference definition

design.cold: same common scoring start; estimator state initialized at that start
design.warm: only legal pre-scoring history; if test-prefix 20-frame warmup is used, score every route from frame 220 and state that warmup changes the scoring origin
design.geometry: calibration frames only; same IQ and frozen geometry across all four routes
design.downstream: identical downstream estimator settings and physical reference
stopping: truth/q_proxy enters estimator input or route selection
physical reference or scoring frames differ
state coordinates cannot be aligned without an undocumented transform

allowed: bounded mechanism comparison when the original 400-402 archive is restored
claims.classification: mechanism diagnostic, not new held-out evidence

run_policy.first_run: one seed only after all input checks pass
